title: [WT-18c] Docs: worker role docs for the unlanded route, LANDING-CONFLICT/RETRY resume and WT-10 gate wording
description:
This is the second worker-role-doc slice split from WT-18 (task-1b2e6fe3ba1343c8ab02271510131155). Its shape follows architect-0fcb7226 in #architects msg-ba081c4f.

It runs once WT-10 (task-5c2e6cdf2494412ca0c2bc40e26d9da3), WT-11 (task-dd1ee586b90d4fc785434454b1423e76) and WT-18a (task-692a12df337c43edacb59fd0599ecff2) have landed. It touches no wrapper-lane file, so it can run alongside WT-12/WT-13. It must land before this project's worktree switch; the human approved that early switch (flip checklist pinned in #general msg-717a48e0).

Objective: document for workers what HEAD's landed wrappers do, and only that:
- the unlanded route (finalize_attempt outcome 'unlanded', the rescue ref, task.landingRetry), as a row in worker.reference.md's commits table;
- the practical rule for a session whose prompt starts with LANDING-CONFLICT: or LANDING-RETRY:, as WT-11's wrappers implement it;
- any completion-gate wording that WT-10 changed.

Files:
- docs/roles/worker.md
- docs/roles/worker.reference.md
- packages/moe-daemon/src/generated/initFiles.ts, regenerated from a `git clone --shared` snapshot as in WT-18a. The GLOBAL no-in-place-build rail applies.

NOT in scope: CLAUDE.md, scripts/CLAUDE.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (WT-18), and any behaviour that is not on HEAD.
definitionOfDone: worker.reference.md's commits table has an unlanded-route row matching HEAD's WT-11 wrappers: finalize_attempt outcome 'unlanded', the rescue ref and task.landingRetry, with codes spelled as on HEAD.

worker.md or worker.reference.md states the rule for a session whose prompt starts with LANDING-CONFLICT: or LANDING-RETRY:, as HEAD's WT-11 wrappers implement it, plus any completion-gate wording WT-10 changed; nothing beyond HEAD is presented as shipped.
`npm run lint` passes (40-line cap); worker.md contains no concrete task id and keeps its test sentinels.

packages/moe-daemon/src/generated/initFiles.ts equals the generator output from a snapshot and changes only the worker-doc entries; the targetedContextGuidance, qaCommitPolicy and initFiles vitest files pass there.

implementationPlan.note: Inventory from HEAD 7cd8e423 (WT-11 landed). unlanded_reason map: conflict (MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_CONFLICT, MOE_WORKTREE_UNRESOLVED_CONFLICT); contention (MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_REF_CONTENTION, MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_LAND_LEASE); gate (MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_GATE); diverged (MOE_LAND_TARGET_DIVERGED); remote (MOE_LAND_FETCH_FAILED, MOE_PUSH_FAILED). Prompt prefixes LANDING-CONFLICT: <paths> and LANDING-RETRY: <reason>, both injected by worktree_resume, which merges the target into W with --no-commit --no-ff. Prompt text: edit files only, no git commands, no new plan; remove markers <<<<<<<, =======, >>>>>>>; re-run the plan's verification; call moe.complete_task. wt_merge_check scans markers and fails MOE_WORKTREE_UNRESOLVED_CONFLICT. MOE_PUSH_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: no finalize, attempt stays finalizing, no ref moves. WT-10: a configured gate runs on every worktree landing on the merged tree; MOE_DISABLE_QUALITY_GATE=1 gives MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_GATE. Every token exists in both wrappers. No files edited.

implementationPlan.description:
docs/roles/worker.md: change lines 12 and 18 only, editing in place. Add NO line: lint caps the file at 40 lines, and it sits in every worker turn's stable system prefix. Use the Edit tool only (GLOBAL rail; WT-18 also declares this file, so an unwitnessed edit is held at landing; mem:gotcha-contested-path-needs-edit-tool-to-land).

Line 12 (qualityGate):
- Keep today's clause verbatim, scoped to shared mode.
- Add the worktree arm as WT-10 landed it. Suggested text: '- If `settings.qualityGate` is set: in shared mode, post-flight runs it before the completion commit on the epic's FINAL task (default scope) and a failure diverts your work to a rescue ref instead of the branch — on that task, run the gate command yourself before `complete_task`. In worktree mode it gates every completion, whatever `qualityGateScope` says, on the merged tree that would land, and a failure lands nothing on the target — run it yourself before every `complete_task`.'
- Adjust the wording to the step-1 inventory.

Line 18 (Session discipline): after the RESUME sentence, add one pointer sentence. Suggested text: 'A prompt starting `LANDING-CONFLICT:` or `LANDING-RETRY:` means your last completion did not reach the target: follow the LANDING rule in `worker.reference.md` (edit files only; leave git to the wrapper).'

Constraints:
- No concrete task id (`task-<32 hex>`) and no 'PREFLIGHT_'.
- No phrase matching /never (?:runs|executes|touches) git|runs no git|does not run git/i (daemonGitDocs.test.ts scans this file).
- Keep every sentinel: 'what Moe supplied', 'truncated, omitted or missing', 'a navigation aid, never a reason to skip a read', 'once per session', 'advance `contextEpoch` after every compaction', 'isolated-clone delivery', 'moe.record_commit', 'fresh remote fetch', 'sessionId'.
- Leave WT-18a's line 13 as it is.
implementationPlan.note: Edited worker.md line 12 (worktree gate arm) and line 18 (LANDING pointer) with the Edit tool. No line added.
Replaced the worktree table's third row with the unlanded route, added the unknown-push sentence and the LANDING rule bullet after the RESUME bullet.

implementationPlan.description:
Regenerate the daemon's vendored copy with WT-18a's recipe: mem:convention-role-doc-edits-regenerate-initfiles, mem:gotcha-moe-doc-generated-artifacts, mem:gotcha-daemon-linux-snapshot-gate.

1. Build a snapshot with history:
   `H=$(git rev-parse HEAD); S=$(mktemp -d); git clone -q --shared --no-checkout . "$S/repo"; git -C "$S/repo" checkout -q --detach "$H"`
   Copy ONLY the two edited docs into `$S/repo/docs/roles/`. Then, in `$S/repo/packages/moe-daemon`, run:
   `env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24.21.0/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin" bash -c 'npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error && npm run generate-init-files'`
   Expect the output line `Generated … (8 role docs + 3 subagents, sha-stamped)`.
2. Run `diff -u` of the tree's packages/moe-daemon/src/generated/initFiles.ts against the clone's. Expect:
   - the 'worker.md' and 'worker.reference.md' ROLE_DOCS entries: the marker sha plus the edited lines, inside a template literal (`\` becomes `\\`, a backtick becomes `\``, `${` becomes `\${`);
   - one new sha in each of those two SHIPPED_ROLE_BODY_SHAS lists.
3. Apply each hunk to the tree's file with the Edit tool.
   - NEVER cp, mv or redirect the generated file into the tree. WT-18 declares this path, so an unwitnessed write is held at landing.
   - The Edit tool trims a trailing space in new_string, so end every substring on a non-space character.
4. `cmp` the tree's file against the clone's output; they must be equal.

If a hunk for any other doc appears, HEAD's copy went stale. Apply it too and name the doc and commit in the summary.

Error handling: if the clone, npm ci or the generator fails, rerun once. If it fails again, report_blocked with the error tail and blockedOnTaskIds [].

Never run npm in the shared checkout's packages (GLOBAL rail 1).
implementationPlan.note: Generated from a git clone --shared snapshot at HEAD with the two edited docs; diff held only the two worker entries and their sha lists. Applied 8 hunks with the Edit tool; cmp equals the generator output.

Unknown push is not called unlanded. Shared-mode clause of line 12 is verbatim and line 13 is untouched. initFiles.ts diff holds only the worker entries and their sha lists. All three paths were written with the Edit tool.

comments.content:
Planner note from WT-18a (task-692a12df, architect-0fcb7226, planned 2026-11-02 at HEAD e4e122cd). Two things you inherit:

1. worker.md line 12 (the qualityGate rule) is yours. WT-18a leaves it byte-identical, and its verification checks that against HEAD. Reason: HEAD's worktree-mode gate (run_frozen_gate worktree on the merged tree, the git-land-<target> lease, two rounds with a gate, MOE_DISABLE_QUALITY_GATE refusing) comes only from WT-10's WIP checkpoint d3441bf3, and WT-10 is still WORKING. The last landed bytes (WT-08/WT-09/WT-10G, d3441bf3^) refuse every worktree completion while settings.qualityGate is set, whatever the scope: "settings.qualityGate is set and gated worktree landing is not available yet". Document whatever WT-10 finally lands, not the WIP.

2. WT-18a adds a separate **Worktree mode** block to worker.reference.md's "Commits, checkpoints and rescue refs" section. The block has its own 3-row Exit | What lands | Where table (completion to the target as one squash commit; checkpoint to moe/task/<taskId> only; a completion that cannot reach the target lands nothing there, the bytes stay on moe/task/<taskId>, and a failed round parks a rescue ref at its tip), followed by a worktree attribution paragraph. The shared-mode table stays byte-identical under a "Shared mode" label. Your unlanded-route row belongs in the worktree table: extend or replace its third row. Your LANDING-CONFLICT:/LANDING-RETRY: rule goes in Practical rules. WT-18a's verification bans that vocabulary (LANDING-CONFLICT, LANDING-RETRY, landingRetry, unlanded, land lease, LAND_LEASE, git-land-, refs/moe/board), so all of it is yours.

Recipe for initFiles.ts: apply the generator's hunks with the Edit tool and cmp them against a clone's generator output (mem:convention-role-doc-edits-regenerate-initfiles). WT-18 and this row declare the same file, so a cp back would be held as contested.
